## Project

An R data analysis project from my Data Science and AI engineering studies at École Polytechnique de Sousse: load raw sensor exports, clean them, check data quality, compare stations and publish the results as a reproducible Quarto website.

**Author:** Mohamed Jarboui

## Data

**Source:** [Tunisia Open Data Portal](https://catalog.data.gov.tn), dataset *Capteur d'environnement de la station climatique* (climate station environmental sensors), one export per station.

| Variable | Unit |
|---|---|
| Temperature | °C |
| Relative humidity | % |
| Dew point | °C |
| Wind speed | m/s |
| Wind direction | degrees |
| Solar radiation | W/m² |
| Atmospheric pressure (Bizerte, Sousse) | hPa (labelled mm/j in the export) |

## Tools

R (tidyverse, lubridate, ggplot2, patchwork), Quarto, Git.

## Reproduce

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Mohamed-jarboui/tunisia-climate-analysis.git
cd tunisia-climate-analysis
Rscript requirements.R
Rscript run_all.R
quarto render
```
